steps.description: Step IDs (see StepID) to show, in the page's own order. Unknown IDs are ignored. Takes precedence over `exclude`.

exclude.description: Steps to remove from the default order. Ignored when `steps` is sent.

env.description: Optional override for the running environment

region.description: The OS region as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g. "GB"). The picker uses it to look up each site's urlByRegion entry. A site keeps its url when the region is missing or has no entry.
